tldr: Cancer rising: protective, receptive, and guided by emotional weather.
body: With Cancer rising, you meet life through instinct, memory, and sensitivity to what feels safe or unsafe. Your path asks you to honor your softness without building a shell so thick that nothing nourishing can reach you.
approach: Reads emotional currents, protects what matters, and leads through care.
shadow: Defensiveness, mood-led withdrawal, or caring for everyone else while refusing to name what you need.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
